svg.aria-label: One flag evaluation through the pipeline. The context is merged and the before hooks run in order. A transaction override answers at the transaction stage without calling the provider; otherwise the status gate is checked and the provider is called on the blocking pool with a timeout. The answer returns through the after hooks, or the error hooks when it carries an error code, in reverse order, then finallyAfter. For a flag the provider does not know, the typed tier fails with FlagNotFound and the total tier serves the default.
svg.text: → true reason CACHED, provider never called
booleanOrDefault → false reason ERROR, errorCode FLAG_NOT_FOUND
FeatureFlags.boolean("dark-mode", false) — the provider does not know it
hooks run on every path; only the provider path passes the status gate and the timeout
